questions.question: How should I deliver the verified dev work to dstrader's main?

options.label: Merge, push, remove worktree
options.description: Merge --no-ff into dstrader main in the canonical checkout, push origin main, then remove the worktree + delete the branch. Full close-out; prod rebuild happens later from main per ticket noUE.

options.label: Merge + push, keep worktree
options.description: Same merge + push, but leave the worktree (its toolchain/build is already set up) in case the prod rebuild is convenient from there. Tear down later.

options.label: Don't merge yet
options.description: Leave the branch committed and unmerged for you to review/merge yourself. I stop here.

questions.question: Move the feature board item (…ni4o, 'Alert when the daily asset run...') ?

options.label: Set to In Progress
options.description: Code done & verified but not deployed; In Progress reflects that deploy (ticket noUE) is pending.

options.label: Set to Done
options.description: Treat the feature as delivered now that the code is merged; deploy tracked separately by noUE.

options.label: Leave as Todo
options.description: Don't touch the board item; I'll only manage the prod follow-up ticket.
